title: Process Mining-Enabled Federated Anomaly Detection for the Industrial IoT
abstract: arXiv:2611.17869v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While federated anomaly detection enables the integration of local data insights across diverse nodes to reduce false positives, it inherently struggles with non-IID data. In practice, industrial IoT plants often operate under varying conditions and experience diverse environmental phenomena, resulting in significant heterogeneity in the monitored time series. In such settings, standard federated learning approaches fail to perform nuanced aggregation that accounts for these cross-node differences, ultimately leading to increased false positive rates. In this paper, we propose a process mining approach to evaluate the similarity of local node data against a reference provided by a global node. The global node utilizes these similarity metrics to dynamically weight local models during aggregation, producing personalized updates distributed across the network. translated_title: 基于流程挖掘的工业物联网联邦异常检测
translated_abstract: 联邦异常检测虽然能够整合多个节点的本地数据洞察以减少误报，但其固有难点在于应对非独立同分布数据。在实际中，工业物联网工厂往往在不同条件下运行，并经历多样的环境现象，导致被监测的时间序列存在显著异质性。在这种环境下，标准的联邦学习方法无法进行充分考虑节点间差异的细致聚合，最终导致误报率上升。本文提出一种基于流程挖掘的方法，用于评估本地节点数据与全局节点所提供参考数据之间的相似度。全局节点利用这些相似度指标在聚合过程中对本地模型进行动态加权，从而产生分布到整个网络的个性化更新。我们使用从制造工厂收集的工业物联网时间序列数据对该方法进行了评估。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于流程挖掘的联邦异常检测方法，通过评估本地节点数据与全局参考数据的相似度来动态加权聚合各本地模型，从而在非独立同分布的工业物联网时间序列数据上实现个性化更新并降低误报率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a process mining-enabled federated anomaly detection approach that dynamically weights local models during aggregation based on their similarity to a global reference, enabling personalized updates and reducing false positives on non-IID industrial IoT time-series data.
